in_marathi.name: Hariraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Hari, ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hariraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hariraj is a Sanskrit name derived from Hari, the god of preservation, and raj, meaning ruler or king. This name is believed to evoke the divine presence and bestow its bearer with the qualities of protection, power, and wisdom.
